Name: Eemie's Cute Long Hairstyles
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: A conversion of Eemie's hairstyles to Content Patcher and Get Glam
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

A conversion of Eemie's "Cute Long Hairstyles" to Content Patcher and Get Glam.  Will not override the vanilla hairstyles, hopefully future proofing it a bit!  This also means you can use a mod that overrides any vanilla styles alongside this one.

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) OR [Get Glam](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5044) to work.

THIS MOD WORKS WITH SDV 1.4

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) OR [Get Glam](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5044)﻿

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy the '[CP] Eemie's Cute Long Hairstyles' or '[GG] Eemie's Cute Long Hairstyles' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  You're done; run the game using SMAPI!

Update log

Tip of the hat to [jhunichi](https://community.playstarbound.com/members/jhunichi.728516/) on the forums for their work making anhttps://community.playstarbound.com/threads/migrating-xnb-mods-to-content-patcher-packs.141577/page-4#post-3267152[unofficial conversion](https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/migrating-xnb-mods-to-content-patcher-packs.141577/page-6#post-3273640), though I did not use any of their coding work for this conversion.

Source code found [here](https://github.com/minervamaga?tab=repositories)﻿.  Feel free to [submit a pull request](https://help.github.com/en/articles/creating-a-pull-request)﻿ with improvements or translations.  You can also [report issues or request features using the Issues tab](https://help.github.com/en/articles/creating-an-issue)﻿!
